title: 第168章 右都统人选第167章 抢人
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 州军大营。
关于云王府的消息也渐渐传到了这里。
眼下，大都统营帐。
高桐端坐主位，面前是军中高层，包括最近声名鹊起的陈望。
“诸位，梁都统为国捐躯，但这右都统之位不能一直空缺，你们做何感想？”高桐扫过众人，沉声询问。
右都统掌管后勤，至关重要，所以人选就显得格外重要了。
“大都统，属下想推举赵霖赵司马。”左都统谢辞远率先开口。
左都统主要是负责军队作战，而谢辞远在钟守正时期，就是都统，在军中威望不小。
而他所推举的赵霖，担任军中司马一职，主要负责军法军纪方面的事务。
高桐眸光一沉，面露不悦。
赵霖是赵文渊的次子，若让其担任右都统，再加上谢辞远这个老家伙，那岂不是自己这大都统之位要被架空了？
他绝对不允许出现这个情况，于是看向了旁边一名文官打扮的男子。
“谢都统，属下觉得不妥。”男子当即起身，看向众人，正色道：“赵司马虽在军中颇有威望，但毕竟是文官，对于战事了解不多。”
“所以属下觉得，理应推举潘都尉！”
此话一出，立刻又有一名男子起身：“大都统，属下觉得郑长史说的没问题。”
“更何况潘都尉一直都是跟着梁都统，更加适合。”
高桐见状，这才露出满意之色。
潘旭是自己的嫡系，让他来当右都统之位确实不错。
可这样一来，谢辞远就不乐意了。
他年事已高，再过几年就要退下了，所以才急切想要提拔一名自己的嫡系。
如今梁正恰好死了，给了他机会。
若能将赵霖扶上右都统之位，那自己也能功成身退，不用担心高桐秋后算账。
“郑长史此言差矣。”谢辞远再次开口，声如洪钟：“赵司马在军中任职多年，军法军纪抓得井井有条，怎么就不懂后勤了？”
“难不成按照你的意思，所有文官都不配掺和战事？”
郑长史脸色微变。
他本身就是军长史，负责处理军中文书、人事，同样也是一名文官。
这番指桑骂槐让他心头微沉，但表面还是不卑不亢：“谢都统，下官不是说赵司马不行，只是右都统掌管全军后勤，干系重大。”
“潘都尉跟着梁都统多年，对后勤事务熟门熟路，自然更合适。”
“熟门熟路？”谢辞远冷笑一声：“潘旭一个都尉，懂什么全军调度？真要是出了岔子，你担得起？”
“谢都统。”潘旭脸一沉，道：“属下自认为还是有这方面能力的。”
“哼。”谢辞远冷哼一声：“老子在军中这么多年，你有没有能力，我岂能不知道？”
两边你来我往，吵得不可开交。

The state army camp.
News about Prince Yun's Mansion gradually spread here.
At the moment, most of them are operating accounts.
Gao Tong sat in the main seat, with senior military officials in front of him, including Chen Wang, who had recently become famous.
"Everyone, Liang Dutong sacrificed his life for the country, but the right position of Dutong cannot remain vacant. What do you think?" Gao Tong glanced at the crowd and asked in a deep voice.
The right commander is in charge of logistics, which is very important, so the selection is particularly important.
"General Dudu, my subordinates want to recommend Zhao Lin and Zhao Sima." Zuo Dutong Xie Ciyuan was the first to speak.
Zuo Dutong was mainly responsible for military operations, while Xie Ci was the Dutong during the Zhong Shouzheng period and had great prestige in the army.
Zhao Lin, whom he recommended, served as Sima in the army and was mainly responsible for military law and discipline.
Gao Tong's eyes darkened, showing displeasure.
Zhao Lin is the second son of Zhao Wenyuan. If he is allowed to serve as the right commander, and the old guy Xie Ciyuan is added, wouldn't it mean that his position as the chief commander will be emptied?
He absolutely did not allow this situation to happen, so he looked at a man dressed as a civil servant next to him.
"Thank you, Dutong. I think it's inappropriate." The man stood up immediately, looked at everyone, and said seriously: "Although Zhao Sima is quite prestigious in the military, he is a civilian official after all and does not know much about war."
"So my subordinates feel that Captain Pan should be elected!"
As soon as these words came out, another man immediately stood up and said: "General Dadu, I think what Zheng Changshi said is correct."
"What's more, Captain Pan has always followed Liang Dutong, so he is more suitable."
When Gao Tong saw this, he showed a satisfied look.
Pan Xu is his direct descendant, so it would be good for him to be the right capital commander.
But in this case, Xie Ciyuan would not be happy.
He is old and will retire in a few years, so he is eager to promote a direct descendant of his.
Now that Liang Zheng happened to be dead, he was given a chance.
If Zhao Lin can be promoted to the position of right capital commander, then he can retire without having to worry about Gao Tong settling the scores later.
"Zheng Changshi's words are wrong." Xie Ciyuan spoke again, his voice like a bell: "Zhao Sima has served in the army for many years and has strict military laws and disciplines. Why doesn't he understand logistics?"
"Is it possible that according to your opinion, all civil servants are not worthy of participating in the war?"
Zheng Changshi's face changed slightly.
He is the military commander himself, responsible for handling military documents and personnel, and is also a civilian official.
These accusations made him feel a little depressed, but on the surface he was neither humble nor arrogant: "Xie Dutong, I am not saying that Zhao Sima is not good, but the right commander is in charge of the logistics of the entire army and has a very important stake."
"Captain Pan has been with Liang Dutong for many years and is familiar with logistics affairs. Naturally, he is more suitable."
"We are familiar with the road?" Xie Ciyuan sneered: "Pan Xu, a captain, knows how to coordinate the entire army? If something goes wrong, can you afford it?"
"Thank you, Dutong." Pan Xu's face sank and he said, "I think I still have the ability in this area."
"Hmph." Xie Ciyuan snorted coldly: "I have been in the army for so many years. How can I not know whether you are capable or not?"
There was a lot of quarrel between the two sides.
